First, note the date format: 10-04-1357 is likely DD-MM-YYYY → 10th April 1357.  

Subtract 48 weeks and 4 days:  
48 weeks = 48 × 7 = 336 days.  
Plus 4 days = 340 days total to subtract.  

Start: 1357-04-10.  
Subtract 340 days:  

April has 30 days, so:  
1357-04-10 minus 10 days → 1357-03-31 (April 10 → April 1 is 9 days back, so April 1 back 1 more day = March 31).  
Actually, easier:  

From 1357-04-10:  
Go back 10 days → 1357-03-31 (April 10 → April 1 = 9 days, so March 31 is 10 days before).  

Now from 1357-03-31, subtract remaining 330 days (340 total - 10 = 330).  

1357 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 100? 1357 mod 4 = 1, so not leap).  

From 1357-03-31:  
Back 31 days in March → 1357-02-28.  
Remaining: 330 - 31 = 299 days.  

From 1357-02-28:  
Back 28 days in Feb → 1357-01-31.  
Remaining: 299 - 28 = 271 days.  

From 1357-01-31:  
Back 31 days in Jan → 1356-12-31.  
Remaining: 271 - 31 = 240 days.  

Now in 1356 (leap year? 1356 mod 4 = 0, and not divisible by 100, so yes, leap year).  

From 1356-12-31:

Dec: 31 days → 1356-11-30 (remaining 240 - 31 = 209)  
Nov: 30 days → 1356-10-31 (remaining 209 - 30 = 179)
